description.text: Training Objective The course is designed to train nursing professionals with basic knowledge in humanity and social science, medicine and preventative care as well as the basic theories and skills of nursing, who can be engaged in clinical nursing, preventative care and nursing supervision in the nursing field. Training Requirements Studengts are required to study and grasp the basic theories and laws and regulations relevant to humanity and social science, preclinical medicine, and preventative health; to understand the basic theory, knowledge and skill of nursing, nursing principle and operating technology of acute and chronic patients, and special nursing and care skills; to apply nursing procedures to conduct overall nursing; and to have such basic abilities as in community health services, nursing management and nursing education with some nursing research capacity. Curriculum human anatomy, physiology, pathogenic organism, pathophysiology, pathology, pharmacology, nursing ethics, nursing psychology, health assessment, medical nursing, surgical nursing, nursing for gynecology, obstetrics, and pediatrics, psychiatric nursing, nursing for emergency treatment, community nursing, nursing management and so on. Employment orientation It is suitable for graduates to be engaged in clinicai nursing, nursing management as well as teaching and research work in hospitals at all levels, medical collages and universities as well as medical research institutions. 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. Applicants must Be in good health. 3. High school graduate or equivalent or above.

duration.text: The Nursing at Shandong First Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 2. Aged 18 or above and with a good health 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
